title: 49Agents belongs on your radar
description:
49Agents/49Agents is the kind of repo that can quietly upgrade a developer workflow. Open-source 2D IDE for managing AI agents in native CLIs, terminal, gits, beads issues, and files across multiple projects and machines. Self-host on a single machine via localhost OR host on a cluster via Tailscale OR connect to app.49agents.com (coming soon). It has about 265 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.

https://github.com/49Agents/49Agents

#GitHub #OpenSource #Developer #Programming #Shorts
